description: Request a preview. Follow the returned WordPress login continuation when an owner browser session is required.
name: sitekick_release_preview

enum: Generation is unavailable because private generation assets are not configured. Ask the site operator to restore the required storage and runtime configuration. Do not retry generation until readiness is restored; retain the original idempotency key.

Generation is unavailable for the selected site or its associated domain. Ask the site operator to verify site-specific generation and worker readiness. Do not retry generation until readiness is restored; retain the original idempotency key.
A managed alternative preserves its live page destination. Edit the live WordPress destination, or restore the staged alternative destination, then review again without regeneration.
An older immutable release is active. Check conversion prerequisites and review its native migration before activating a new native release. Existing drafts remain editable; do not regenerate.

Inspect the editable drafts and native publication progress. Preserve manual edits, then resume this exact local operation or prepare a fresh review. Do not regenerate or change the generation idempotency key.
Open the owning website with an account permitted to edit and publish pages; front-page changes also require Reading settings permission.
Resolve the native route or parent-page conflict before generation. Choose an available authorized route; never overwrite an unrelated page.
This binding cannot yet be copied into a native editable page. Remove the unsupported binding before generation; existing generated artifacts remain available without regeneration.
Use a plain-text page title without HTML markup, and keep any blueprint heading consistent with that title.
Heading must equal the page title or blueprint name. Make them match, or omit content.heading.
Summary must exactly match a referenced fact. Add a matching fact and fact_refs; for longer copy, split it into facts of at most 2,000 characters, reference them, and omit content.summary.

x-semantic-constraints: Every navigation key refers to a page
Every page binding reference resolves to a declared binding
Manifest hash and referenced content hashes checked by sealed release builder
Binding IDs resolve only within site_ref
